records.text: A tipster told Candace Owens that Charlie Kirk's UVU event had initially been slated to be held indoors before it was moved; Owens said she had to investigate and was not confirming the tip.
records.speaker: UVU event venue tipster (identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: And I had received a tip—and I do want to check this out, by the way—that they also had initially slated for this event to be inside, but it was moved. ... Again, I have to look into that. I'm not confirming that, but if that's true as well, things are about to get very interesting.

verification.notes: The primary recording shows Owens saying she received a tip that the event was initially slated for indoors and was moved, then immediately saying she needed to investigate and was not confirming it. The statement accurately preserves both the reported tip and Owens's explicit caveat; it does not establish that the venue was actually changed from indoors.
